methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: According to the EnPI-methodology [3], relevant parameters are classified as either efforts, set-points, external parameters

paper_type.evidence_quote: An experimental implementation of the algorithm is validated using a simscape simulation.

level_3b.evidence_quote: As an example of a complex system serves a refrigerating plant consisting of a cooling tower, a cooling water cycle, two chillers, and a chilled water cycle.

stage1.notes: Methodological paper: OptTopo set-point optimization using EnPI (effort/benefit, efficiency=nu/alpha) subsystem models, validated on a Simscape simulation (no empirical case). Application is an industrial cooling/refrigeration utility, not a closed-list continuous-process sector -> level_3b=false. NN model type proposed but only polynomials instantiated.

multi_site.evidence_quote: As an example of a complex system serves a refrigerating plant consisting of a cooling tower, a cooling water cycle, two chillers, and a chilled water cycle.

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: Industrial cooling plants are often (a) composed of several components, (b) linked using network technology

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: the set-point optimization of complex systems by means of decomposition

enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: the ability to combine models of several types (e.g., neural networks and polynomials)
